said.text: … the best legislative vehicle to keep U.S. troops out of Lebanon is the War Powers Resolution introduced by Rep. Rashida Tlaib yesterday, with full support and input from Foreign Affairs Committee Ranking Member Gregory Meeks. … look forward to working with Congressmember Tlaib to support and build consensus for H.Con.Res.108.

did.text: Voted Yes on H.Con.Res. 108, directing the President pursuant to the War Powers Resolution to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities in Lebanon. Failed 189–235.

whyNote: The June 4 statement was issued jointly by Leader Jeffries, Whip Clark, and Caucus Chair Aguilar and named H.Con.Res. 108 as the vehicle they would support; Rep. Jeffries voted yes when it reached the floor on June 30. Full statement at the source link.
